turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning. Please take a seat. Could you both introduce yourselves before we begin?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Good morning, doctor. I am Meera, and this is my brother, who came with me today.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: Hello, doctor. I am Arun. I brought a written list of what happened this week.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you. Meera, please describe how you have been feeling, in your own words.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I have felt tired for several days. Yesterday I also felt dizzy when I stood up at work.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: She called me in the afternoon. When I arrived, she was sitting down and having some water.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Meera, when did the tiredness begin, and has it been constant or does it come and go?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: It began on Monday. It comes and goes, but I notice it more after a busy morning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Arun, please read the times from your notes, then I will ask Meera a few more questions.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: The first call was at two fifteen. We left the office at three, and she rested at home that evening.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I slept earlier than usual last night. This morning I felt a little better, but I was still worried.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Thank you both. I will check your observations and examine you before we discuss the next steps.

turns.speaker: Attendant
turns.text: I will keep the notes here. Please let me know if you need any other details.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doctor. I would like to understand what we should keep track of after this visit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We will go through that together once the examination is complete. Please relax your arm for now.
